sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The Need
Transport for NSW maintains and operates vehicular ferry sites across New South Wales.
This procurement initiative aims to secure reliable fuel suppliers for ferries located at Sackville, Lower Portland, Webbs Creek, Wisemans Ferry, Mortlake, Berowra Waters, and Bluff Point.
Reliable fuel suppliers must be contracted by the end of September 2026 to ensure continuity of service before the current purchase order allocation is exhausted.
Key Information
• Transport for NSW operates nine vehicular ferry sites across New South Wales, serving as a lifeline for communities throughout the state. The maintenance and ongoing operation of these ferry services depend critically on a steady and dependable fuel supply. Without consistent access to fuel, TfNSW would be unable to sustain the level of service that communities rely upon, making fuel provisioning a key operational priority.
• A three-year fuel supply contract has been estimated to serve the following locations:
Sackville, Webbs Creek, Wisemans Ferry, Lower Portland, Mortlake, Berowra, and Bluff Point.
• Tenders will be evaluated based on price competitiveness and the supplier's capacity to deliver fuel on schedule. All suppliers must comply with Transport for NSW safety and environmental specifications and standards.

sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
In order to gain access to the Request for Tender documents, Tenderers are required to register their interest by sending an email: TSS.Bidder@transport.nsw.gov.au and include the following:
Tender No and Title,
RFT ID,
Organisation Name,
ACN/ABN,
Contact Name,
Organisation/contact postal address,
Contact email address (preferably an email address with the contact person's name),
Contact phone number
To gain access to the tender documents in Ariba over the internet once access is provided, please ensure that you are using PC with web browser:
Google Chrome 54+ (64-bit)
Microsoft Internet Explorer 7–11 (32-bit)
Mozilla Firefox 24 or 27 (ESR)
Safari 9+ (64-bit) OR
Microsoft Edge (32-bit)
